summary: Build an end-to-end physical-AI application on Viam using supplied robot arms, cameras and compute. MongoDB is a co-host.
eligibility: Rolling-approval applications. Software, Linux, Git and JSON familiarity expected; no robotics experience needed. Fee, age and international admission unconfirmed.
title: Viam Robot Hackathon: Physical AI & Data

prize.description: Winners receive SO-101 robot kits; gold/silver/bronze tiers of US$5,000 / 2,500 / 1,000 in credits from each of Viam and MongoDB Atlas. Credits, not cash.

notes: 29–30 October at the Robotics Center of Silicon Valley, San Francisco; demos 30 October at 15:30.
